First, we note that

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to -\infty }(4{x}^{13}) & ={lim}_{x\to -\infty }(4\cdot {x}^{13}) \\  & =4\cdot {lim}_{x\to -\infty }{x}^{13}.\end{aligned}
$$

The graph $y={x}^{13}$ is power function with an odd positive power and therefore has the property that

$$
{lim}_{x\to -\infty }{x}^{13}=-\infty .
$$

Multiplication by the positive constant $4$ does not affect the limit at infinity. So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}4\cdot {lim}_{x\to -\infty }{x}^{13}={lim}_{x\to -\infty }{x}^{13}=-\infty .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that

$$
{lim}_{x\to -\infty }(4{x}^{13})=-\infty .
$$
